status_note: A summary written for ELI Legal, in its own words. It is not the text of the instrument and has not been validated by a qualified lawyer. Check the official text before relying on any statement in it.
licence_note: EU legislation may be reused under Commission Decision 2011/833/EU. The wording of this summary is the software's own.
title: EU AI Act: high-risk AI system under Annex III, point 8(a)
issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
description: ELI Legal is a high-risk AI system under Article 6(2) and Annex III, point 8(a): it is intended to assist a judicial authority, or to be used in a similar way in alternative dispute resolution, in researching and interpreting facts and the law and in applying the law to a concrete set of facts. Article 6(3) was considered and is not relied on. The requirements of Chapter III, Sections 1 to 3 apply to Annex III systems from 2 December 2027, in every member state.

requirements.title: Used within its intended purpose
requirements.text: The system is used only to assist a person in researching and interpreting the facts and the law of this dispute and relating them to each other. It does not decide, and its output is not the decision.

requirements.title: No assessment of persons
requirements.text: The system makes no assessment of any person's character, credibility or likelihood of offending and infers no personal characteristic.
requirements.instruction: Do not assess any person's character, credibility, honesty or likelihood of offending, and do not infer personal characteristics such as health, ethnic origin, religion, political opinion or sexual orientation.

requirements.title: Risks are controlled throughout the work
requirements.text: Known risks to the matter (a wrong, outdated or misquoted authority, an unread or hostile document) are identified and held for a person to decide, and the residual risks are stated in the report.

requirements.title: Data with recorded provenance
requirements.text: Every document and every legal source has a recorded origin, version and date, and only approved legal sources are used.

requirements.title: Events are recorded automatically
requirements.text: Every step, tool call, source version, model and prompt version, hold, decision and release is recorded in a tamper-evident log from the first run.

requirements.title: Output that can be interpreted, with its limits stated
requirements.text: The report says what was verified, by which check and by whom, what was not, and the limits of the document.

requirements.title: Human oversight
requirements.text: A named person who understands the system's capacities and limits reviews the output, can decide not to use it or to override it, and can stop the work at any time.

requirements.title: Awareness of automation bias
requirements.text: The person overseeing the system remains aware of the tendency to rely too readily on its output.
requirements.statement: I have checked the findings I rely on against their sources, rather than relying on how the report presents them.

requirements.title: Accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity
requirements.text: Each authority is checked for existence, current status and quotation separately; text addressed to an AI system is held; identities are proven; the network is denied by default.

requirements.title: Oversight by competent people
requirements.text: The deployer assigns human oversight to people who have the competence, training and authority it needs.
requirements.statement: I have the competence, training and authority to oversee this system's use on this matter.

requirements.title: AI literacy
requirements.text: People who operate or use the system have a sufficient level of AI literacy for the context in which it is used.

requirements.title: Logs are kept
requirements.text: The deployer keeps the automatically generated logs for at least six months, unless other law provides otherwise.

requirements.title: Informing the people affected
requirements.text: People subject to decisions made with the assistance of a high-risk AI system are told that it is used.
requirements.statement: The parties have been, or will be, told that an AI system assisted the preparation of this matter.

requirements.title: Fundamental-rights impact assessment
requirements.text: A deployer that is a body governed by public law, or a private body providing public services, assesses the impact on fundamental rights before first use.

requirements.title: Machine-generated text is identifiable
requirements.text: Text generated by an AI system is identifiable as such.
requirements.statement: Any passage marked as drafted by a model was generated by an AI system. Such passages are labelled and kept apart from findings taken word for word from the documents.

requirements.title: Explanation of the system's role
requirements.text: A person affected by a decision taken on the basis of a high-risk system's output may obtain an explanation of the role the system played. The evidence pack for the run records what the system did.

requirements.title: Monitoring and serious incidents
requirements.text: The provider monitors the system after it is placed on the market, and serious incidents are reported to the market surveillance authority of the member state where they occurred.
